title: Portfolio Pruning
summary: Portfolio simplification and a defined Tesla short.
coverage_note: All numbered text blocks and image labels read. Material theses, forecasts and explanations are included; routine holdings lists, incidental statistics, company descriptions and boilerplate are excluded. Chart pixels were not inspected.

evidence.title: Tesla 2020 short invalidation path
evidence.finding: Following September 20, 2020, first daily high above split-adjusted 166.6667 occurred November 19: high 169.5367 (=508.61 in 2020 units). September 21 close 149.7967 (=449.39), September 24 close 129.2633 (=387.79). Initial favorable move preceded stop breach; no actual fill, borrow cost or prior exit verified.

evidence.title: Three-for-one split
evidence.finding: Tesla declared 3:1 split, trading adjusted August 25, 2022. Therefore a 2020$500 threshold corresponds to $166.6667 in vendor back-adjusted historical OHLC.

framework_lessons: An explicit invalidation level makes a thesis falsifiable.
assessment: The Tesla setup failed its stated stop condition after an initial favorable move. Five-year sensitivities sharply separate successful Facebook exposure from losing Alibaba and JD exposure. Portfolio simplification and income improvement require holdings-level reconstruction, so they are not credited as automatic performance gains.
